title: Corrected Meanings of the Five Classics
subtitle: Classical commentary, state education and standardised knowledge
shortSummary: The Corrected Meanings provides an entry into how Tang classical commentary entered state education and regimes of interpretation.
curatorialDescription: The museum does not treat it as a single embodiment of Confucian thought; it shows the relationships among compilation, commentary, education and institution.
Together with Kong Yingda, the Guozijian and an Analects passage, it forms a traceable micro-network of classical learning.
researchNote: Compilation, fascicles, textual genealogy, official-school use and Kong Yingda's individual contribution still need precise mapping.
